items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He’s doing a great job. He sends me royalties for the print copies he sells.

ctx.x: Oliver Nelson. He‟s doing a great job. He sends me royalties for the print copies he sells. So I don‟t get into the publishing too heavy.
But obviously you‟re taking care of the business, because in music there‟s the art and then there‟s the business, and most of us artists, we don‟t really want to deal with the business.
